bare-email.json.reason: a bare, colonless identifier is not a person identifier: there is no implicit scheme and no legacy alias for the pre-WRIT-102 format

bare-handle.json.reason: a bare handle carries no scheme

empty-scheme.json.reason: scheme must match [a-z][a-z0-9+.-]* and so cannot be empty

empty-value.json.reason: value must be at least one character

scheme-over-limit.json.reason: scheme is 33 characters, over the 32-character bound

scheme-underscore.json.reason: underscore is outside the scheme charset [a-z0-9+.-]

scheme-uppercase.json.reason: scheme charset is [a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*; an op body carries the normalized form, whose scheme is lowercased

value-over-limit-multibyte.json.reason: value is 321 code points (642 bytes), over the bound: the bound counts code points, not octets

value-over-limit-supplementary.json.reason: value is 321 code points (642 UTF-16 code units, 1284 bytes), over the bound: the bound counts code points, not UTF-16 code units and not octets

value-over-limit.json.reason: value is 321 code points, over the 320-code-point bound; rejected, never truncated
